verdict_rules.Met: Inside the promised range, or at most 5 percentage points above a stated floor (T_floor <= actual <= T_floor + 5.0)
verdict_rules.Beat: More than 5 percentage points above the top of the range or stated floor (actual > T_top + 5.0)
verdict_rules.Missed: Below the floor or range (actual < T_floor or actual < T_min)
verdict_rules.Unclear: Delivered metric differs from promised metric (revenue vs volume), or no comparable figure disclosed
